description: This file implements a screen recording service for macOS, using ScreenCaptureKit and AVFoundation. It includes functionality to start/stop recording, handle audio/video streams, and manage recording errors.

classes.name: StreamRecorder
classes.description: A helper class responsible for writing the captured video and audio samples to a media file, managing AVAssetWriter and its inputs, and handling state transitions during recording.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Main method to initiate screen recording with specified parameters such as screen index, duration, frame rate, audio inclusion, and output path. It manages the capture process, timing, and cleanup.
